title: Username normalization keeps mixed case
issue: normalizeUsername should trim whitespace and return a lowercase username.

title: Pagination drops the last item
issue: paginate should include every item and must not create an empty trailing page.

title: Money total has floating-point drift
issue: sumAmounts should add the input amounts, then round the final aggregate to two decimal places. Do not round each input separately.

title: String false is treated as enabled
issue: parseBoolean should accept booleans, numeric 1/0, and common true/false strings while ignoring letter case and surrounding whitespace. It should reject unknown values.

title: Deduplication keeps the wrong record
issue: uniqueById should keep the first record for each id without changing input order.

title: Retry waits after the final failure
issue: retryDelays should return delays only between attempts, never after the final attempt.

title: Token redaction leaks repeated tokens
issue: redactTokens must redact every bearer token regardless of letter case.

title: Payload limit rejects exact boundary
issue: isWithinLimit should accept payloads whose size equals the configured limit.

title: Task sorting mutates caller data
issue: sortByPriority should return sorted tasks without mutating the input array.

title: Date-only comparison depends on local time
issue: isSameUtcDay should compare calendar dates in UTC, including offset timestamps.
